teaser: VoiceDebrief is ready for market: record, transcribe and debrief on the device, save to a vault. A simpler relaunch, under its own name and accounts.
core_idea: Relaunch VoiceDebrief around its working core, move the agent workflows to the CRM app, and launch it properly with its own accounts and real payments.
